exact_proposed_source_scope.intent: DecodeEnvelope host.configure branch recognizes exact all-null default scope, or complete session scope. Register a write method with dedicated default path; authenticate local principal and trusted configuration port. Execute performs global principal+command lookup before scoped lookup for all v2 methods, reserve only genuinely new commands inside caller Tx, retains original cancellation ACK finalization. Typed rejection rollback must not orphan identity; original response remains sole authority. Successful configure gets post-response semantic validation before commit. host.status reads current durable owner/principal head/configs, not injected ConfigRevision0.

Private domain configuration authority port and handler: authenticated host/principal, metadata-only credential/provider check, stage new immutable configuration and advance host head on EVERY successful configure. Optional settled Session CAS changes model_config_ref and revision exactly once in same original command transaction. No call to qualification, scheduler or MODEL. Typed stable status projection; original rows unmodified.

Explicit amendment to frozen foundation required: factor private typed session-scope path while preserving original default-only helper rejection tests; read validator recognizes exact default or session scope, joins actual project identity rather than hardcoded empty project, verifies original response SessionID/revision/result and canonical full request. Existing three SQL tables/constraints unchanged. History validation never requires current Session ref to equal an older configured ref.

Explicit narrow amendment: existing unconditional response.SessionID==request.SessionID is incompatible with actual session.create COMPLETED. Accept only that method-specific derived ID when nonempty result.session_id, response SessionID, request project and persisted creation attribution match; reject all other mismatch. Keep goal.start null top-level creation response. Preserve canonical fullhash/global namespace/ambiguous legacy refusal and sole original journal.

An unqualified saved config can create an offline Session; NORMAL/goal execution still requires original admitted runtime. Current authoritative task/run/queue/control/pending permissions checked before rebind, not caller settled flag. No reinterpretation of existing historical Run binding.

For configured sessions compare exact typed model_config_ref + provider/model/endpoint/credential-ref against current RuntimeRegistration artifact model_config.ref and private host provider route; zero/ambiguous/mismatched mapping fails closed. Preserve currentRuntimeAdmission at actual send/dispatch, task route identity and frozen dispatch/profile. No auto-created RuntimeRegistration, profile alias or Model.ref substitution.

Lookup entire principal+command namespace before configuration or session changes; same request replays original result before checking now-stale writer, changed request conflicts across method/project.

Legacy exact existing receipts return unchanged without automatic identity backfill. This is important for old host.status prefixed principal representation. New commands reserve global identity inside original Tx; rollback failure aborts entire Tx. Never create a second receipt or status table.

Validate current owner head, complete scope, credential metadata and optional Session settlement/CAS. Savepoint protects rejected requests: no config/head/session/queue mutation survives; persist only legitimate rejected original response/identity after rollback.

After commit report ConfigureResult; session-bound client refreshes session.get. No invented CONFIG_CHANGED event (frozen event enum has none), no second journal, no new Run/claim/worker or automatic resume. Snapshot/current revision is authority.

runtime_binding.actual_names: Current implementation uses profile[model_config][ref], ClientSession.ModelConfigRef/client_sessions.model_config_ref, and RuntimeProviderRoute.ModelConfig. There is no newly assumed RuntimeProfile.Model.ref field.

Configuration version and principal remain immutable. Current broker also Hash(provider.ModelConfig)==Hash(admitted.profile.model_config), original PREPARED binding retained.
runtime_binding.endpoint_open_decision: Configure base_url is a provider base URL; current profile endpoint is dispatch URL. Scope review must fix exact canonical base-to-endpoint mapping for trusted route (e.g. append /chat/completions once); arbitrary URL aliases, query/credentials and fallback forbidden. Do not claim raw base==full endpoint always.
runtime_binding.qualification: Saved config cannot rebind an already-qualified profile to a new mc-ref. Exact new profile/route requires separate original qualification/admission workflow; handler creates none. Repeated configure same payload/new command still gets new ref/revision and is not automatically qualified.
runtime_binding.legacy: Existing pre23 admitted runtime configs remain immutable historical inputs, no insertion of fabricated configuration rows for them. Distinguish legacy exact runtime-only sessions from newly typed config refs by actual stored/creation provenance, not permissive missing-ref fallback. New configured session with deleted/missing typed row must fail. This provenance discriminator is a review gate before implementation.
runtime_binding.old_run: Old dispatch manifests/profile/model/credential refs and UNKNOWN cost/reservations unchanged. Pending task without Run, queued commands, paused/LOST/reconciling Run or unresolved effect/control means busy. Never auto-inherit host head.

credential_and_restore.checks: Only trusted localHost port may inspect matching ref/provider metadata after verifying bound principal. Host.CredentialStatus(ref) alone does not check provider/principal; CredentialUsable decrypts and must not be called on configure path. AVAILABLE metadata is not successful decryption/provider authentication.
credential_and_restore.race: Vault revocation can occur after save; it is not in SQL Tx. Report checked state honestly; original private ModelCredential revalidates at dispatch. Do not promise cross-Vault atomic availability.
credential_and_restore.restore: All3 typed tables + original responses/history bytes retained by accepted23 validator. Historical credential refs remain refs only; restored different host directory must not rewrite owner_host_ref to its Host.InstanceID. Old configs visible only as authorized history where contract permits, cannot be selected as current by silent adoption; new owner config starts its own head. No secret copied into backup.
credential_and_restore.history_validator: Extend readClientConfiguration exactly for new session scope and original response project/Session/revision binding. Current validator calls this for each historic row, so do not compare old row to current session model; session can change later. Real backup/restore/rebackup including old + new session rows is mandatory before integration.
